sql: SELECT s.game_id, SUM(s.play_minutes) AS total_minutes FROM demo_sessions s JOIN demo_player_tags t ON s.player_id = t.player_id AND t.snapshot_date = '20260101' WHERE s.event_date = '20260101' AND t.player_segment = 'returning' GROUP BY s.game_id ORDER BY s.game_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.player_id) AS active_users, COUNT(DISTINCT b.player_id) AS retained_users, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT b.player_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.player_id), 2) AS retention_rate FROM demo_sessions a LEFT JOIN demo_sessions b ON a.player_id = b.player_id AND b.event_date = '20260102' WHERE a.event_date = '20260101'
